text.en: Heavy attacks made with full Sword energy turn you invisible and fire exploding Void projectiles.
Heavy attacks made with full Sword energy turn you invisible and fire exploding Void projectiles.

While grounded, Charged Heavy Attacks release four tracking orbs 8? meters ahead of you and grant <void/>Void Invisibility for 6.3 seconds. Each orb deals <pve 507 /> <pvp [363] /> damage in a ? meter radius with no falloff.
